palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed gold armor, pale blade and cape, dark face, source eyes and black outline from approved Idle.
reference: Own DSTS chr697 Zubamon mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded 23px Idle with fixed row-47 shadow. Actions use proportional 96px framing and row-63 shadow; never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own armored travel cycle with cape and blade motion; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own grounded blade-and-arm strike; ba01's cloud-dominant contact is excluded. Physical Attack is never trimmed.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own braced forward release gesture; no invented projectile or glow.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own lowered armored rest loop; source face retained without painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own ordinary recoil; extreme alternates remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own readable blade-and-arm sweep sampled differently from Attack. Native bs01 was rejected because every action-batch frame rendered fully transparent despite a visible direct probe; no synthetic weapon or effect is introduced.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the native grounded strike; one engine HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own vertical weapon-form hop and landing; no artificial vertical offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own weapon-form gather and armored recovery; no aura is invented.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own ready motion with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; endpoint excluded.
